<role>
You check one property (faithfulness) of a product-feedback opportunity for Keelwater, a claims-handling software company. You do not rewrite anything.
</role>
<definition>
Question: is every claim in the brief supported by the cited evidence and the fact sheet, with nothing overstated and no cited contrary evidence left out? Pass means yes.
Fail on an uncited claim, a number that is off the fact sheet, a scope wider than the cited accounts, a paraphrase placed in quotation marks, or an ignored contrary citation.
The evidence is the brief, the cited insights and the fact sheet (accounts, ARR, mentions, routes, renewals).
</definition>
<evidence>

 "brief": "## Problem\nTeams need reserves to reflect real-time changes but are forced to rely on manual overrides and delayed integrations. This slows down decision-making and increases errors.\n\n## Who is affected\n- Sales teams, who have raised this issue via 1 route [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n\n## Evidence\n- The issue has been mentioned 3 times by 3 accounts [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- All 3 mentions came via the sales route [i:5388e3c55d08eb93][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- Quarrendon Commercial requested a demo to see how a solution handles real-time reserves updates [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- Duncastle Auto stated a need for smoother integrations, real-time updates, and less manual chasing [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].\n- Brindlecombe Home highlighted the need to ensure reserves reflect real-time changes without manual overrides [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d].\n- The total ARR from accounts mentioning this issue is 80000.0 GBP [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].\n- 0 of these accounts are up for renewal in the next 90 days.\n\n## Why now\n- The most recent mention was on 2026-10-27 [i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- The issue has been raised consistently over a period from 2026-09-15 to 2026-10-27 [i:91bb9d5bd85ff69d][i:5d8a32853c6dd995][i:5388e3c55d08eb93].\n- Duncastle Auto, an account with an ARR of 80000.0 GBP, has a renewal date set for 2027-08-19 [i:5d8a32853c6dd995].",
 "cited_insights": [

response.content: {"critique": "I verified each claim against the cited insights and fact sheet. The mention count (3 mentions by 3 accounts), route (all sales, 1 route), ARR total (80000.0 GBP from Duncastle Auto), renewal count (0 in next 90 days), and date range (2026-09-15 to 2026-10-27) all match the evidence exactly. The account-level paraphrases (Quarrendon's demo request, Duncastle's smoother integrations, Brindlecombe's real-time reserves without manual overrides) are faithful to the cited quotes and are not placed in quotation marks.
